effect.name: GM X-Textured
effect.shader: vec3 deform(vec2 p,float t){ t*=2.0; p+=0.5*sin(t*vec2(1.1,1.3)+vec2(0.0,0.5)); float a=atan(p.y,p.x),r=length(p),s=max(r*(1.0+0.5*cos(t*1.7)),0.002); vec2 uv=0.1*t+0.05*p.yx+0.05*vec2(cos(t+a*2.0),sin(t+a*2.0))/s; return texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,fract(0.5*uv)).rgb; } void main(){ vec2 q=acScreenNorm, p=(-1.0+2.0*q)*textureScale; vec3 col=vec3(0.0); for(int i=0;i<16;i++) col+=deform(p,time*speed+float(i)*0.0035*strength); col/=16.0; col=pow(max(col,vec3(0.0)),vec3(0.6,0.7,0.8)); vec4 src=texture2DCv(inputImg.texture,acScreenNorm); gl_FragColor=vec4(mix(src.rgb,col,blend),src.a); }
